text:
lina: FYI a customer on Cloudflare Workers reported our SDK crashing at runtime. stack shows "process is not defined" and a failing require('crypto') when used from an ESM worker bundle.

omar: can you drop their minimal bundle output / entry import?

lina: they do `import { Client } from 'redwood'` in a worker file. esbuild picked the CJS entry from our package and the worker ended up with Node-only bits. error snippet: 
```
ReferenceError: process is not defined
  at Object.resolve (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:xxx)
  at Module._load (internal/modules/cjs/loader.js:xxx)
  at require (internal/modules/cjs/helpers.js:xx)
  at Object.<anonymous> (node_modules/redwood/dist/index.cjs:9:15)
```

tia: yeah Workers have no Node globals. We should ship a dedicated worker-safe build plus hinting so bundlers prefer that.

colin: options: add an `exports` map entry like "worker": "./dist/index.worker.mjs", or flip to `module` ESM only and keep a `cjs` top-level if we need it. also consider `browser` field for older bundlers.

lina: types worry: TS expects a single `types` path. maybe add a single `index.d.ts` and include `declare module 'redwood/worker' { export * from 'redwood'; }` pattern so consumers get typings when they import the worker path.

omar: good call. on the crypto side: use webcrypto when available (`globalThis.crypto?.subtle`) and guard `require('crypto')` behind `if (typeof process !== 'undefined')` so bundlers can tree-shake it away. example: 
```
const webcrypto = typeof globalThis?.crypto?.subtle !== 'undefined'
  ? globalThis.crypto
  : (typeof require !== 'undefined' ? require('crypto').webcrypto : undefined);
```
And replace Buffer.from with `new Uint8Array` helpers in worker build.

tia: also watch any dependency that pulls in `process.env` references. Rollup/esbuild can inline but sometimes the CJS build still references it. we should avoid directly using `process.env` in runtime code.

ci-bot: CI: build:cloudflare failed on PR #428 during `bundle:worker` step: `Could not resolve "crypto" from node_modules/redwood/dist/index.cjs` — assigning to @omar.

colin: we should add a small integration test that runs Miniflare in CI (modules mode) to catch regressions. put it under `integration/cloudflare/`. also add a sample in `devex/samples/cloudflare/` that shows `import Redwood from 'redwood/worker'` with minimal generate call.

lina: action items: @omar create `index.worker.mjs` (no Node APIs) + update package.json `exports` with `worker` subpath; @tia add typings augmentation file; @colin add Miniflare CI job and sample app.

omar: will open a small PR today. plan: copy `dist/index.mjs` -> `dist/index.worker.mjs`, replace Node-only bits with guarded alternatives, remove Buffer usage. will link a local repro using `miniflare --modules` in PR.

tia: I'll draft the declaration augmentation and doc blurb for the README about the `redwood/worker` import.

colin: nice, this fix should reduce support tickets from edge customers. thanks team. :rocket:
